fields.description: Weekly issue featuring editorials and local commentary on South Florida civic and political affairs, including a local-option racing bill, Miami Beach adopting prohibition at midnight, criticism of the Volstead Act and enforcement, discussion of Miami municipal finances and public-utility costs (including Florida Power & Light), election-related commentary (Chamber of Commerce and city commission), and assorted local notes, letters to the editor, advertisements, and recurring humor columns (e.g., "Little Geraldine").
